chosen_pattern.summary: Replace Supabase Data API assumptions with app-owned backend APIs and worker data APIs backed by backend PostgreSQL.
chosen_pattern.reason: The current web and worker code depends on Supabase PostgREST URLs, anon/service-role keys, and RPC paths. Backend PostgreSQL alone cannot satisfy those HTTP and authorization semantics safely.

provider_modes.purpose: Read backend PostgreSQL for comparison only.

required_capabilities.backend_contract: HTTP API returns published feed rows from backend PostgreSQL without exposing database credentials.
HTTP API returns article detail and summaries from backend PostgreSQL.
HTTP API uses reviewed SQL or database functions for search, with bounded limits.
Server-only admin API uses least-privilege backend credentials and existing admin session checks.
Server-only write endpoints execute rollback-tested backend PostgreSQL writes.

required_capabilities.supabase_dependency: worker PostgREST batch reads, upserts, and refresh_public_feed_snapshot RPC
required_capabilities.backend_contract: Worker API or direct server-side client uses least-privilege backend credentials, not Supabase service-role keys.

authorization_replacement.browser: No database credential or service-role style token is exposed to browser code.
authorization_replacement.server_admin: Admin routes keep existing app auth/session checks before using backend database credentials.
authorization_replacement.worker: Worker credentials are scoped to worker-owned least-privilege reads/writes and rotate separately from app credentials.
authorization_replacement.rls_replacement: Any authorization previously depending on Supabase RLS must move into backend API authorization and focused SQL grants before backend_postgres_primary.

cutover_blockers: All required capabilities pass against backend PostgreSQL in non-production.
App and worker repos can run backend_postgres_shadow without production response changes.
Service-role style Supabase access is removed from backend_postgres_primary paths.
Smoke tests and parity validation pass after writer pause.
Rollback to supabase_primary is documented and tested before production cutover.

checks: backend_postgres_primary guarded write skipped when writes are enabled

validation.live_status: backend app and worker routes are provisioned; protected apply and app shadow parity smoke passed; production cutover remains blocked until writer pause evidence, rollback coverage, and final approval pass
